meta.title: feat: lazy load CLI command actions for improved startup performance
meta.body_summary: Implement lazy loading for all CLI command actions, deferring heavy imports and startup operations (update checks, DB migrations, config loading) to reduce CLI startup time by ~15.7% according to internal benchmarks.

perf_labels.notes: Claude Code performed large lazy-loading refactor; bot reviews flagged numerous regressions and telemetry gaps; author iterated fixes but PR remained unmerged.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 199,681 changed lines across 142 files, this is a massive change by absolute volume, largely inflated by merge commits that brought unrelated main branch changes. The core refactor involved restructuring every CLI command to use dynamic imports, a large-scale architectural overhaul. The outcome (closed without merge) reflects that the change introduced many functional regressions and required extensive iteration, ultimately not gaining maintainer acceptance.

review_details.concern_detail: Cursor bot and coderabbit identified >20 bugs including missing --instructions option, incorrect command signatures (show, validate, list), telemetry regressions, parameter parsing issues, and configuration capture bugs.
review_details.performance_claim: 15.7% overall CLI startup improvement (from 971.84ms to 819.00ms) via lazy loading of command actions.
review_details.rejection_signals: Extensive bot-flagged bugs and breaking changes; no formal approval from maintainers; PR closed after long iteration without merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent attempted a system-wide lazy-loading optimization but introduced many regressions in CLI command interfaces, missing parameters, and telemetry. The agent's changes required multiple rounds of fixes, indicating difficulty in maintaining backward compatibility across a large surface area.

detection_detail.code_reading: Automated bots (cursor and coderabbit) performed static analysis, flagging numerous issues with command signatures, telemetry, and configuration.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Performance claims based on manual benchmark scripts that were later removed; no maintainer validation of the numbers.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge after extensive iteration; bot-flagged issues were partially addressed but never fully resolved.

core_change_summary.description: Refactored all CLI commands in promptfoo to separate command registration (lightweight) from action execution (heavy), moving the latter into dynamically imported *Action.ts files per command, with lazy loading in main.ts for update checks, DB migrations, and config loading.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most line churn stems from a large merge commit bringing in unrelated main branch changes; the core refactor spans ~40 files.
change_trajectory: Initial lazy loading implementation for several commands.
Merge main, add benchmark scripts then remove them.
Multiple rounds of fixes addressing bot reviews (option signatures, telemetry, config handling).
Final bug fixes, but PR closed without merge.

review_signals.summary: Provided 12 nitpick comments and many refactor suggestions across the PR (process exit consistency, optional chaining, type safety).
Reported missing numQuestions parameter in assertions generation and telemetry regressions.
review_signals.action_taken: Author added the missing parameter and telemetry fields.

review_signals.summary: Flagged broken command signatures for show, validate, list, and others.
review_signals.action_taken: Author restored original signatures and subcommands.

review_signals.summary: Commands captured empty defaultConfig due to closure over initial values.
review_signals.action_taken: Author adjusted to load config before registration.

review_signals.summary: Author posted updated performance numbers (43-53% faster help commands) and claimed to have fixed all identified issues.

collaboration_trajectory: Claude Code opened the large-scale lazy loading refactor on Jul 13.
Author merged main, removed benchmark artifacts, and addressed initial CI failures.
Automated reviews from cursor and coderabbit flagged dozens of regressions.
Over the following two weeks, author pushed multiple rounds of fixes restoring command interfaces and telemetry.
Despite extensive bug fixing, the PR received no approval and remained open; eventually closed without merge.
